content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Kanpur Project Executive Officer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Executive Officer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Executive Officer post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Energy, or Power Systems is required, with excellent academic records in Bachelor's and Master's degrees. Relevant post-PhD experience and programming skills are also essential.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Executive Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 50,400 to Rs. 1,26,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Project Executive Officer position at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Executive Officer is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIT Kanpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any specific programming skills required?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are expected to have hands-on experience with MATLAB and/or Python programming.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is needed besides academic qualifications?
faq.answer: Post-Ph.D. significant experience in an academic or research institute/university of national or international repute is required, along with experimental work experience with digital simulators/controllers.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
